description: Shell-braid derivation of the sp³↔pure-p bond-angle base flip. (A) palindromicity-orbital-type: s (ℓ=0) is palindromic/self-dual ⇒ symmetric-block (trivial) character; the s electron word e⁻=σ₀σ₁σ₀ is a palindrome; p is chiral ⇒ standard block. s,p sit in different Wedderburn blocks; hybridisation mixes them at the s–p promotion gap. (B) electron-shell-braid-capacity: ns Hopf-links the (n−1) inner shells ⇒ Δ(n) ∝ (n−1) = central-atom size; integer ⇒ DISCRETE flip; window closes at n=2→3. (C) group-16 O 104.5°→S/Se/Te ~90° flat confirms. Derives the mechanism + direction + discreteness; the exact Δ-vs-bonding numbers (atomic Φ₁ penetration model) remain open.

data.finding: The sp³↔pure-p base flip is DERIVED from the framework: (A) s-orbitals are self-dual (palindromic Hecke NF, the e⁻ word is a palindrome) ⇒ symmetric-block character = the q² block; p-orbitals are chiral ⇒ standard block; hybridisation mixes the blocks at the s–p promotion gap. (B) the ns penetrates the (n−1) inner shells (each a Hopf-linked electron word), so the gap Δ(n) ∝ (n−1) = the central-atom SIZE — the owner's size-amplification, now structural. Δ integer ⇒ DISCRETE flip; window closes at n=2→3 (O sp³ vs S pure-p), group-16 saturation confirms. Open: the exact Φ₁ penetration numbers pinning the threshold value.
